chapters.name: Sets
topics: Sets and their representations
Empty set; finite and infinite sets; equal sets
Subsets; subsets of the real numbers, especially intervals (with notation)
Universal set; Venn diagrams
Union and intersection of sets; difference of sets
Complement of a set; properties of complement
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): practical problems on union and intersection of two sets

chapters.name: Relations and Functions
topics: Ordered pairs; Cartesian product of sets; number of elements in the Cartesian product of two finite sets
Cartesian product of the reals with itself (up to R x R x R)
Relation: definition, pictorial diagrams, domain, co-domain and range
Function as a special relation; pictorial representation; domain, co-domain and range
Real-valued functions: constant, identity, polynomial, rational, modulus, signum, exponential, logarithmic and greatest integer functions with graphs
Sum, difference, product and quotient of functions
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): composition of functions

chapters.name: Trigonometric Functions
topics: Positive and negative angles; radians and degrees and conversion
Trigonometric functions via the unit circle
Identity sin²x + cos²x = 1; signs of trigonometric functions
Domain, range and graphs of trigonometric functions
sin(x ± y) and cos(x ± y) and simple applications
Identities for tan(x ± y), cot(x ± y), sum-to-product formulae
Identities for sin 2x, cos 2x, tan 2x, sin 3x, cos 3x, tan 3x
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): general solution of sin y = sin a, cos y = cos a, tan y = tan a

chapters.name: Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations
topics: Need for complex numbers, motivated by quadratic equations with no real solution
Algebraic properties of complex numbers
Argand plane
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): polar representation; statement of the Fundamental Theorem of Algebra; quadratic equations with real coefficients in the complex number system

chapters.name: Linear Inequalities
topics: Linear inequalities
Algebraic solution of linear inequalities in one variable and representation on the number line
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): graphical solution of linear inequalities and systems of linear inequalities in two variables

chapters.name: Permutations and Combinations
topics: Fundamental principle of counting
Factorial n
Permutations and combinations; derivation of formulae for nPr and nCr and their connections
Simple applications

chapters.name: Binomial Theorem
topics: Historical perspective; statement and proof for positive integral indices
Pascal's triangle
Simple applications
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): general and middle term in binomial expansion

chapters.name: Sequence and Series
topics: Sequence and series
Arithmetic mean
Geometric progression: general term, sum of n terms, infinite GP and its sum
Geometric mean; relation between AM and GM
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): formulae for the sums of k, k² and k³ for k = 1 to n

chapters.name: Principle of Mathematical Induction
topics: Process of proof by induction
Natural numbers as the least inductive subset of the reals
The principle of mathematical induction and simple applications

chapters.name: Straight Lines
topics: Recall of two-dimensional geometry
Slope of a line and angle between two lines
Forms of the equation of a line: parallel to axis, point-slope, slope-intercept, two-point, intercept
Distance of a point from a line
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): normal form; general equation of a line

chapters.name: Conic Sections
topics: Sections of a cone: circle, ellipse, parabola, hyperbola; point, straight line and pair of intersecting lines as degenerate cases
Standard equations and simple properties of parabola, ellipse and hyperbola
Standard equation of a circle

chapters.name: Introduction to Three-dimensional Geometry
topics: Coordinate axes and coordinate planes in three dimensions
Coordinates of a point
Distance between two points
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): section formula

chapters.name: Limits and Derivatives
topics: Derivative as rate of change, of distance and geometrically
Intuitive idea of limit
Limits of polynomial, rational, trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions
Definition of derivative and its relation to the slope of a tangent
Derivatives of sum, difference, product and quotient of polynomial and trigonometric functions
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): derivatives of composite functions (chain rule)

chapters.name: Statistics
topics: Measures of dispersion: range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation of ungrouped and grouped data

chapters.name: Probability
topics: Events: occurrence of events, 'not', 'and' and 'or' events
Exhaustive and mutually exclusive events
Axiomatic (set-theoretic) probability and connections with earlier theories
Probability of an event, and of 'not', 'and' and 'or' events
notes: Assessed formatively only (not in the year-end paper): random experiments; outcomes; sample space (set representation)
